basic_details.short_information: One contractual post of Officer on Special Duty (OSD) for Works is open at the headquarters of Central Agricultural University (CAU), Imphal, Manipur, for engineers with a Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering and at least 10 years of regular service as Executive Engineer (Civil) at Pay Level-11. The engagement is for 179 days at a fixed remuneration of ₹55,000 per month. Applications in the Annexure-I format can be sent by post to The Registrar or submitted online through www.cau.ac.in, and must be received by 4:30 PM on 4 December 2026.

how_to_apply: Fill in the application form in the format given at Annexure-I of the notice, and paste a recent passport size photograph on it.
Give the details the form asks for: name, date of birth, gender, Aadhaar No., educational qualifications, address for correspondence, mobile number and email.

Enter employment details in chronological order, courses or training attended, previous experience, APARs of the preceding 5 years and any additional information on suitability, using separate sheets where space is insufficient.
Sign the form and attach the supporting documents as per the information given in the application form.
For offline submission, address the application to The Registrar, Central Agricultural University, Imphal – 795004, and write the name of the post on the envelope.
Make sure the application is received by 4:30 PM on 4 December 2026.
Applications received after the closing date, without the prescribed documents, or otherwise incomplete or not in the prescribed format are liable to be rejected.

content_sections.heading: CAU OSD (Works) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: OSD (Works) – Officer on Special Duty (OSD) for Works
Offline (by post to the Registrar) or online through www.cau.ac.in

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The single OSD (Works) vacancy is unreserved (UR). The notice lists two essential criteria, and a candidate must meet both: Must possess a Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University or Institute. Must have at least 10 years of regular service in the grade of Executive Engineer (Civil) at Pay Level-11. The application form also asks for a full record of employment in chronological order (organisation, post held, period, emoluments or pay level and nature of duties performed), training programmes attended, previous experience and the APARs of the preceding 5 years. Age limit and age relaxation are not specified in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The OSD (Works) will be paid a fixed remuneration of ₹55,000/- per month. Other service conditions will be as per the existing rules of the University for contractual appointment. The period of contract is 179 days. The period may be extended on review of the task and performance of the contract appointee. The initial appointment will be for 179 days, which can be extended subsequently depending upon satisfactory performance and as per the requirement of the University. The contract can be terminated by either side at any time by giving one month's notice. The University can terminate the contract immediately by paying one month's agreed remuneration in lieu of the notice period.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CAU OSD (Works)
content_sections.text: Fill in the application form in the format given at Annexure-I of the notice, and paste a recent passport size photograph on it. Give the details the form asks for: name, date of birth, gender, Aadhaar No., educational qualifications, address for correspondence, mobile number and email. Enter employment details in chronological order, courses or training attended, previous experience, APARs of the preceding 5 years and any additional information on suitability, using separate sheets where space is insufficient. Sign the form and attach the supporting documents as per the information given in the application form. For offline submission, address the application to The Registrar, Central Agricultural University, Imphal – 795004, and write the name of the post on the envelope. For online submission, visit www.cau.ac.in . Make sure the application is received by 4:30 PM on 4 December 2026. Applications received after the closing date, without the prescribed documents, or otherwise incomplete or not in the prescribed format are liable to be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only short-listed candidates will be called for interview. The date, time and venue of the interview will be conveyed in the interview call letter. Candidates must make their own arrangements to reach the place of interview, and no TA/DA will be paid by the University for attending it. The decision of the University on selection of candidates will be final, and no correspondence in this regard will be entertained.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CAU OSD (Works) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy of OSD (Works), and it is unreserved (UR).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the CAU OSD (Works) post?
faq.answer: Applications must be received by 4:30 PM on 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for CAU OSD (Works)?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University or Institute, and at least 10 years of regular service in the grade of Executive Engineer (Civil) at Pay Level-11.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of CAU OSD (Works)?
faq.answer: The post carries a fixed remuneration of ₹55,000/- per month; other service conditions follow the University's existing rules for contractual appointment.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the CAU OSD (Works) post?
faq.answer: Fill in the Annexure-I form and send it with supporting documents to The Registrar, Central Agricultural University, Imphal – 795004, with the post name on the envelope, or submit online through www.cau.ac.in.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for CAU OSD (Works)?
faq.answer: Only short-listed candidates will be called for an interview, whose date, time and venue will be given in the interview call letter.

faq.question: Q7. Is the CAU OSD (Works) post permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a contractual engagement for 179 days, which may be extended depending on satisfactory performance and the University's requirement.

faq.question: Q8. Will CAU pay TA/DA for the OSD (Works) interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be paid by the University to attend the interview; candidates must make their own travel arrangements.

faq.question: Q9. Can the CAU OSD (Works) contract be ended early?
faq.answer: Yes, either side can end it at any time with one month's notice, and the University can end it immediately by paying one month's agreed remuneration in lieu of notice.
